title: Teach-back: follow-up, no mastery

turns.text: Give me something short to read on moments.
I read it. Can I explain it back to you?
A moment is force times the perpendicular distance from the pivot, so moving the load out raises the torque the servo must give.

reviewer_notes: The vague summary gets a follow-up question; the good one gets the guide's application question. No mastery claim, no verdict or score.
